title: Haaye Chehlum Hogaya
body:
THI YEH ZEHRA S.A. KI SADAA HAAYE CHEHLUM HOGAYA.
LUT GAYA SAB GHAR MERA HAAYE CHEHLUM HOGAYA.
BAS GAYI KARBOBALA HAAYE CHEHLUM HOGAYA.
1. AAYI WO SHAAME GHAREEBA'N CHAA GAYA HAR SOO DHUAA'N.
ZALZALE ME THI ZAMEE'N AUR QOON ROTA AASMAA'N.
TISHNALAB PYASON KE GHAM MEIN MUZTARIB THI ALQAMA.
WAADA POORA KAR DIYA SHABBIR ASWS. NE JO THA KIYA.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. HAAYE DASWI KO MUHARRAM KI QAYAMAT AAGAYI.
DARD O GHUM KI EK FIZA KARBOBALA PAR CHAA GAYI.
KARBALA KI DAASTA'N HAR EK KO RULWA GAYI.
GOONJEGI TAA HASHR DUNIYA ME YEH MATAM KI SADA.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. AAYI JAB RAN SE SADA AKBAR ASWS. KI BABA LO SALAAM.
KARBALA KE DASHT MEIN THA ZAALIMO'N KA IZ-DEHAAM.
GIRTE THE RUN MEIN MUSALSAL SHAAHE DEE'N HAR EK GAAM.
JIS GHADI LASHE PE POHONCHE GHAM SE DIL THARRA GAYA.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. HAATHON PAR BABA KE ASGHAR ASWS. TEER KHAKAR CHAL BASA.
KARB KA MANZAR NA SHAH KA DEKH PAAYE AMBIYA.
GURBATE SHABBIR ASWS. PAR AANSOO BAHAYE KARBALA.
KHODKAR ASGHAR ASWS. KI TURBAT, SHIMR L.A. NE KAATA GALA.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. KARBALA KE DASHT MEIN SHADI AJAB DEKHI GAYI.
TEEN DIN KI BHOOK AUR PYAASE BARAATI THE SABHI.
EK ABAA MEIN LAASH AAYI QAIME MEIN NAUSHAH KI.
CHAND LAMHO'N MEIN WO GHAR, SHADI KA THA MATAM SARA.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. HAYE WO AUN O MOHAMMED ASWS. HAQ PE QURBAA'N HOGAYE.
MAA SE JO WAADA THA POORA KAR GAYE IS SHAAN SE.
RUQ KIYA NA SUE DARYA DONO PYARE CHAL BASE.
AAYE JAB LAASHE TO MAA NE, SHUKR KA SAJDA KIYA.
Kalaam: JANAB RAZA ALI SOHAIL SAHAB.
